environment: Queensland rooftop solar uptake keeps climbing as spring sunshine drives another surge in clean energy switch-overs
Great Barrier Reef coral spawning season begins with marine scientists reporting encouraging signs of recovery on key reef sites
science: Australian researchers push forward on reef-friendly sunscreen and coral resilience trials to help protect the reef long term
sports: Queensland footy fans buckle in as NRL and AFL finals fever hits home with local sides fighting for a shot at the big dance
stories.overview: Brisbane-made Bluey keeps charming the world, proving a good wholesome story never goes out of style

segments.title: The Open
segments.script: G'day and welcome to ParkSyde Bright Side, it's Wednesday the sixteenth of September and I'm Alex Mercer, glad you could join us. We've got a ripper show lined up, some good news from the environment desk, a bit of science, the footy finals heating up and Sam's got the weather sorted for the week ahead. And I'm Jamie, and I reckon spring's really starting to show off around the place, isn't it. There's a real spring in everyone's step today, pardon the pun, we've got plenty to smile about. You always say that pun like it's the first time. Let's get into it, plenty of good stuff to cover before the kettle boils dry.

segments.title: Green Desk
segments.script: First up, our environment wrap, and it's a beauty. More Queensland households are jumping on the rooftop solar bandwagon this spring, with panels going up on roofs from Cairns right down to the border. It's one of those quiet good news stories that just keeps rolling along in the background. Yeah and it makes sense too, we get more sunshine hours than just about anywhere, so may as well cash in on it. Meanwhile out on the reef, the coral spawning season has kicked off and marine scientists are chuffed with what they're seeing on some of the healthier patches. It's basically the reef's version of a big family reunion, all happening under the moonlight out on the water. Small wins like that add up, and it's nice to hear some hopeful news out of the reef for a change.

segments.title: Science & Tomorrow
segments.script: Over in the science world, researchers are still hard at it trying to build a better sunscreen, one that protects us without giving the coral a hard time. It sounds like a small thing but it could make a real difference for reef health long term. It's clever stuff too, they're looking at how certain coral species bounce back from stress, hoping to breed a bit of extra toughness into the reef for the warmer years ahead. Bit like giving the reef its own version of a gym membership. Slow and steady science, but it all adds up over time. Worth remembering next time you're slapping on the sunscreen before a swim, pick one that's reef friendly if you can.

segments.title: Weather
segments.script: Cheers Alex, good to be with you both. Spring's well and truly settled in across the south east, we're looking at mostly sunny skies through the week with Brisbane tops sitting around the mid twenties and overnight lows dipping into the low teens, so still worth grabbing a jumper for the evenings. There's a gentle north easterly sea breeze kicking in most afternoons which will keep the Gold Coast and Sunshine Coast beaches pretty pleasant for a paddle. UV levels are already creeping up into the extreme range around midday, so slip slop slap is back on the agenda even though it doesn't feel all that hot yet. No major rain on the radar for the next few days, just the odd high cloud drifting through, so it's shaping up as a cracking week to get outdoors around the region.

segments.title: The Scoreboard
segments.script: Righto, footy time, and this is my favourite time of year, finals season is here for both codes. NRL and AFL finals are in full swing and there's a real buzz around the place with Queensland sides still very much in the mix. I love finals footy, everyone suddenly becomes an expert down at the local coffee shop. There's nothing like that finals tension, one week you're a hero and the next you're planning the family holiday early. Too true, that's the beauty of knockout footy, it keeps you honest. Whoever your team is, get around them these next couple of weeks, it's shaping up as a cracking finish to the season.

segments.title: Overview & Outro
segments.script: Now before we go, our feel good story of the day, and it's one close to home. Our little Brisbane made cartoon Bluey is still winning hearts all over the world, from lounge rooms here to loungerooms overseas. It really is lovely isn't it, a homegrown show about a family from right here in Queensland, making people smile everywhere. Proof that good, honest stories still travel the furthest. Couldn't agree more, sometimes the simple stuff really is the best stuff. That's about it from us for today's Bright Side. Thanks for hanging out with us, get outside, enjoy that spring sunshine, and we'll catch you all again tomorrow. Look after each other out there. Too right, take care Queensland, see you next time on ParkSyde Bright Side.
